note: The ZIP local header supplies the extra-field length; the candidate sets it to 4 even though no extra-field bytes follow the file name.
The input-controlled extra-field length is converted into a request to read 4 bytes into the stack buffer.
The short read at end of input returns fewer bytes than handledextralen, but the code does not require n to equal handledextralen before parsing the buffer.
The parser is called with the requested length rather than the actual number of initialized bytes read.
parseExtraField reads bytes from the uninitialized tail of the stack buffer as extra-field metadata.
